description: This file defines a static class for diagnostics related to the Orleans code generator, specifically for handling cases where [GenerateSerializer] is used in reference assemblies. It includes constants for diagnostic IDs, messages, descriptions, and a method to create diagnostics based on symbols.

classes.name: ReferenceAssemblyWithGenerateSerializerDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostics for improper use of [GenerateSerializer] in reference assemblies within the Orleans code generator.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object for a given symbol, indicating an error if [GenerateSerializer] is used in a reference assembly.
